text:
maya: Quick thought 1: propose a 'swift decision' mini-chooser in the rollout header for emergency fallback actions. One-row, low friction, full audit. Who's in? :thinking_face:
ezra: In. We need to tie it explicitly to rollout id + route. Show both in the row to avoid scope mistakes.
devon: Strong +1. Minimal controls: Mode dropdown (soft-throttle | quarantine | fallback-model), Duration presets (15s/60s/5m), Severity toggle (informational/standard/escalated), Silent (suppress notifications).
kat: Must show "matched signals" snapshot inline: (5xx: 12%, p95 latency: 1.3s, quota breaches: 4). Sort by impact.
sara: Important: require a short justification when severity increases or Mode escalates. Record that verbatim.
maya: Also: show estimated deltas next to mode (cost delta, invocation delta, p99 change). Operators want quick tradeoffs.
ezra: Backend: emit deterministic breadcrumb id format: decision:<yyyymmdd>T<hhmmss>:<rollout-id>. Also include a sampling token pointer for matched telemetry like tb-20260322-0009. No random UUIDs.
devon: For replayability: breadcrumb + snapshot token are required fields. Example audit event we can log:```{
  "event":"swift_decision.apply",
  "actor":"maya",
  "rollout":"rollout-314",
  "route":"/v1/chat",
  "mode":"quarantine",
  "severity":"escalated",
  "duration":"60s",
  "reason":"spike 5xx us-west",
  "breadcrumb":"decision:20260322T101530:rollout-314",
  "snapshot":"tb-20260322-0009"
}```
kat: That JSON is great for infra. UI should show friendly copy: "Applied quarantine to /v1/chat (60s) 1 reason: 5xx spike in us-west" and a "view sample traces" link.
sara: Undo policy? Allow an immediate 'revert' button for 2 minutes that records a revert audit entry with a short reason. Limit reverts to 3 per rollout per 10m to prevent thrash.
maya: Rate-limits make sense. Also add a small concurrency hint: "Last action by X at T; new action will override."
ezra: Security note: only operators with 'contingency.write' permission can escalate severity. Show disabled states and tooltips explaining why.
devon: Good. For cost estimates, backend should compute conservative bounds and surface them as "estimated +/-5%" so operators know uncertainty.
kat: UX nit: match signals should be expandable. Default show top 3 with impact bars. Expand to raw counts and sample ids when needed.
sara: On telemetry retention: store sampled snapshots for at least 48 hours so decision-sim and postmortem can replay.
maya: We should add an opt-in "attach repro set" checkbox when matched signals indicate prompt-related failures; captures a tiny sample for ML team debugging.
ezra: Also add a deterministic event id for simulator: contingency-replay:<breadcrumb> so the sim can find it easily.
ops-bot: Preview deployed: https://console-preview.internal/swift-decision?pr=1501 (simulated signals + toy replay).
devon: I'll draft a 1-pager RFC with: mockups, telemetry contract (breadcrumb + snapshot token + replay id), audit schema, revert/rate-limit rules, permission gating, and estimated delta fields.
kat: Add a short section on how to display actions taken by others to avoid collisions (locked state or "pending by" line).
sara: Sounds good. Maya, please include example payloads and the exact breadcrumb format in the RFC. Bring to ops sync next week.
maya: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
